animations.name: strong kick
animations.prompt: Fixed full-body 16-bit pixel art fighting-game side view, facing RIGHT. Use the supplied first and last poses exactly, preserving identity, outfit, footwear, pixel art, scale and ground baseline. One powerful strong kick from standing guard to full extension. Pivot onto the planted supporting foot, lean the torso low forward-left while reaching the near arm out left-down and pulling the far arm behind the shoulder for counterbalance, and drive a powerful high diagonal kick upward-right into the exact final pose. Preparation occupies roughly the first third; the kick accelerates smoothly and reaches maximum extension cleanly at the final frame. Keep the ground contact anchored on the ground baseline; end exactly on the supplied impact pose. Locked camera, no zoom, no pan, no extra props, no motion trails or effects.
